steps.name: injectRealFile
steps.script: return fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8935/wmsoffice-model-for-import-test.json').then(function (r) { return r.text(); }).then(function (text) { var file = new File([text], 'model.json', { type: 'application/json' }); var dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); var openBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(function (b) { return b.textContent.trim() === 'Open model only'; }); var section = openBtn ? openBtn.closest('section') : null; var input = section ? section.querySelector('input[type="file"]') : null; if (input) { input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return { foundButton: !!openBtn, foundInput: !!input, fetchedLength: text.length }; });
steps.label: Fetch WmsOffice's real model.json and inject it into the file input
